moves.detail: FUT.GG this update: 84s at 650 cost 0.78 coins per point, 85s at 2,000 0.95, 86s at 4,000 0.98 and 87s at 5,800 1.05. 84s are cheapest, but 81–84 sit at a hard 650 floor. Use them in SBCs, don't trade them: selling costs the 5% tax.
